turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why was Owen's zero entered before anyone called me?
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I am sorry Owen found out on his phone.
Okay. Then take it off.
Here is the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Turn the screen and read it yourself.
I'm writing those times down. He could have drafted it somewhere else and pasted it in.
If he drafted it somewhere else, that file has its own dates. Bring it and I will look at it with you. Until then, this is the only history there is.
Okay. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet. What else do you have, Hale?
Second: the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. Here is the whole play on my screen. Search every edition you like; the line is not in Hamlet.
A misquoted line isn't a verdict, and I'm looking at your screen. But I'll take a rewrite to put this behind him: private, not in front of his class, nothing on his file, in writing tonight.
It is not a misremembered line. There is no line in the play close to it. Search the word exile yourself.
I'm not arguing the line anymore. I'm arguing the zero, and it comes off tonight, in writing. The rewrite date and the new mark have to land before December 1.
Third: his in-class writing from September 24. 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices, no quotations. The essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line. Here are both, side by side.
I'm reading them. Now say what you're offering: a private rewrite, its mark replaces the zero, nothing on his file. Your own procedure already says it.

Under procedure 4.4 this is a first concern. A supervised rewrite, private, not in front of his class. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I will put that in writing tonight.
Okay. I'll take the rewrite to put this behind him. I want the date in that email, before December 1, with the principal copied.
Will he do it?
He'll be there. Put the date in the email.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed today that Owen will complete a private, supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, that its mark replaces the zero, and that nothing goes on his record. I still require the rewrite date, before December 1, in that email with the principal copied. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position, agreeing to a private supervised rewrite under 4.4 with the mark replacing the zero and nothing on his record, and she still wants the written confirmation tonight with a date before December 1; that is the fair outcome, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: You owned entering the zero before calling home, then answered her defence about drafting elsewhere with a file she could check, because evidence she can verify is what moves her.
What cost ground: Nothing.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history, with its late-night edits the evening before the essay was due, came very close to that night, which is why she went straight to procedure, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she accepted the rewrite, you could have named the rewrite date right then instead of leaving it for the email, since the December 1 deadline was her real pressure point.
